verses.text: "Come, let us return to the LORD. He has torn us to pieces, but he will heal us. He has wounded us, but he will bandage our wounds.
After two days he will bring us back to life. On the third day he will raise us up, so that we may live in his presence.
Let us know the LORD. Let us keep trying to know him. As surely as the sun rises, he will appear. He will come to us like the rain, like the spring rains that water the land."
"What can I do with you, Ephraim? What can I do with you, Judah? Your love is like the morning mist, like the dew that disappears early in the day.
That is why I cut you to pieces with my prophets. I killed you with the words I spoke. My judgments flashed out like lightning.
I want faithful love, not sacrifices. I want you to know God more than I want burnt offerings.
But like Adam, they have broken my covenant. They were unfaithful to me there.
Gilead is a city of evildoers, stained with footprints of blood.
Like gangs of robbers waiting to attack someone, the priests band together and murder on the road to Shechem, committing shameful crimes.
I have seen a horrible thing in Israel. Ephraim has turned to prostitution, and Israel is unclean.
"And you, Judah, a time of harvest is also set for you, when I bring my people back from captivity.
